reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Upgrade Go to `v1.24.4`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The item, listed under 'Other (Cleanup or Flake)', describes only a build-toolchain upgrade (Go to v1.24.4) and states no effect on deployed environments, so there is no operational consequence for an operator.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded the Go toolchain used to build it to v1.24.4, a cleanup item with no operator-facing effect described in the release note.
